description: lexicon's rehearsal world, Open Autonomy's own on this cookbook: the platform built from this tree (apps/platform/world.ts) on the twins — the model gateway (the openai twin, scripted by rehearsal/model/scenario.ts), GitHub, Discord, Stripe (cards out), Polar (money in), the npm registry — with a deployed service the page compares with main (rehearsal/live.ts) and GitHub Actions played by the kit's runner. Nothing here calls a real API. ${TWIN:<vendor>}, ${KIT_DIR}, ${REHEARSAL_DIR} and ${SCENARIO} are rendered by the kit's rehearsal. Nothing Hermes set on the process that runs the world enters it (stripEnv): the world's brain has a board and a home of its own, never the outer agent's.
